title: dynamic timestamped multi-line OU zero-label source gate
target: Find an auditable pre-match source that can support Direct-T P(T=0..7+) with multiple total-goal lines, both Over/Under prices, and original timestamps before kickoff.
required_source_properties: football fixture identity and kickoff time
more than one total-goals line for the same fixture/time neighbourhood or an exchange goal-line curve
historical retrieval reproducible enough for strict PIT reconstruction
no target score/result needed to select the source

evidence: Official historical service provides time-stamped Exchange market/price/settlement data from April 2015.
Historical downloads support filtering by sport/date/event/market type and are delivered as market/event files.
Official football Exchange examples expose multiple Over/Under goal markets and Goal Lines.
Historical API requires a Betfair session token and data must first be purchased into My Data.
Historical odds endpoint returns bookmaker-level time-series entries with createdAt/changedAt, price, active state and limits.
Current documentation states historical odds availability since January 2026.
Historical snapshots for featured markets are available from 2020 at 10-minute intervals and from September 2022 at 5-minute intervals.
Historical event-odds supports additional markets after May 2023.
Soccer supports alternate_totals with multiple Over/Under points in current event-odds examples.
Historical endpoints are paid-plan only and require apiKey; soccer/bookmaker alternate-total historical coverage must be measured after access.

scientific_interpretation: The dynamic multi-line OU axis remains scientifically open and structurally feasible, but no provider can be used in this environment without user/account credentials or a paid historical API key. No dynamic OU observations were downloaded and no Direct-T model was run.
fallback_next_step: confirmed-XI/post-lineup late-pre-match zero-label PIT coverage audit; explicit prediction time must be after lineup publication. Do not build or tune a player-rating model in the source gate.
